description: This file defines the CachedCatalogItemServiceDecorator class, which implements the ICatalogItemService interface to add caching behavior for catalog item operations using local storage.

classes.name: CachedCatalogItemServiceDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds caching functionality to catalog item service operations, utilizing local storage to cache items and reduce server calls.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Retrieves a paged list of catalog items, using cache if valid.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Retrieves the list of all catalog items, using cache if valid.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Fetches a catalog item by its ID from the cached list.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item and refreshes the cache.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Edits an existing catalog item and refreshes the cache.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item by ID and refreshes the cache.

methods.name: RefreshLocalStorageList
methods.description: Helper method to refresh the cached list in local storage.
